instructions_to_main_agent.general: You are building a high-end LMS. Do not use default Bootstrap/Material styles. Follow the 'Swiss & High-Contrast' archetype. Use whitespace aggressively.
layout_rules: Avoid center-aligning everything. Use left alignment for text to create a strong reading line.
Use the 'Control Room' grid for the dashboard - dense but organized.
Use the 'Tetris' grid for the magazine library - make it look like a curated newsstand.
Ensure all containers with borders have internal padding (p-6 or p-8).
component_rules: Customize shadcn components to match the 'Swiss' aesthetic - sharper corners (rounded-lg), lighter borders.
Use 'Outfit' font for all headings. Use 'Inter' for body text.
Buttons should have a subtle shadow and active scale effect.
Cards should have a hover lift effect (-translate-y-1).
color_usage: Use the Primary Blue (#0072BC) for primary actions and active states.
Use the Secondary Orange (#FF7B00) sparingly for high-priority alerts or 'New' badges.
Keep the background White (#FFFFFF) or very light gray (#F8FAFC).
Text should be Dark Slate (#0F172A), never pure black.

universal_guidelines.accessibility: Ensure all text meets WCAG AA contrast ratios. Use aria-labels for icon-only buttons.
